notes.title: Formula TOP 1.0
notes.content:
It's 1.0! The main feature of the release update is career mode with it's details, can't wait for you all to try it out.

Besides that there's a big range of general changes:
[list]
[*]car setups
[*]variable tyre life
[*]reliability and engine failures
[*]knockout qualifying
[*]engine modes
[*]team radio messages
[*]pre-race menu with news
[*]event modifiers for teams and drivers
[*]AI drivers may block/ram depending on their dirtiness stat and if the player has crashed with them earlier
[*]lots of new (moddable) data for drivers and teams
[*]new track: Hungary
[*]new engine sound
[*]several new sound effects
[*]new difficulty: Legend
[*]new driver positions hud with used tyre compounds
[*]penalty for illegal compound strategy
[*]hide inactive pit crews to improve performance on low quality setting
[*]minor chances to car drive model
[*]bug fixes and balance tweaks
[/list]

Steam Achievements are also added, they are all for career mode.

notes.title: New feature: Damage
notes.content:
New update is live, get ready to pay for all those crashes! Retiring from the race is also possible now, whether for your car breaking down or just wanting to join the spectators.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42293249/36da54e4f4bc8b570dbdbebbf1a06848a7ede9e6.png[/img]

Full patch notes:
[list]
[*] Added option for damage
[*] Added retiring from the race (on max damage or from the in-game menu, game switches to spectator mode)
[*] Improved AI overtaking (faster reactions, uses slip stream more)
[*] AI now moves over when being lapped
[*] More consistent collision physics
[*] Adjusted default driver AI-skills and car stats
[*] Increased slip stream range
[*] Minor netcode improvements
[*] Minor AI cornering improvements
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Early access is live! Featuring mod support!
notes.content:
The game is now live! Final reveals at launch day include:
[list]
[*] Modding support for single player - Driver names, textures and AI skills plus car stats and textures are moddable and there's a classic formula model option for visuals
[*] A bonus Tiny mode, for which you can unlock all the drivers. Tiny mode is not just cute, it leaves more room on the track for a different style of experience
[*] A top-down chase camera as a bonus. Especially useful if you have trouble with traditional top-down cameras
[/list]

Here is the run down of features for early access that were already announced:
[list]
[*] single player with quick race and championship modes (AI is much improved from summer demo)
[*] spectator mode for watching AI racing
[*] online multiplayer with custom room settings
[*] time trial with online leaderboards for all-time records and weekly challenges
[*] 10 tracks across 5 locations
[*] pit stops: tyre compounds with different speeds and durability
[*] dynamic weather: plan ahead and react during the race, track wetness changes based on weather and effects tyre grip
[/list]

So what's next? The key items on the roadmap are career mode, audio update, performance optimization, Steam Workshop support to help with mod sharing and a steady stream of new tracks. Lots of other QoL-improvements and features like DRS are also in the plans. Join the Discord channel to voice your opinion on all the possible features that could be added to the game!

notes.title: Autumn update for the Playtest
notes.content:
Autumn update for the Playtest is live! Try out the new tracks in practice mode and join the Discord server to see when multiplayer races are on. The full version with AI, career mode, pit stops and more will be released Q1/23.

The most important part of the autumn update is raising the track count from 1 to 4! Ruska Racing Center features three unique tracks in one area: one traditional layout and two very different takes on high speed racing. Rest of the full game's track lineup will consist of realistic tracks.

Some other key elements in the update:
-dynamic camera zoom
-smoother car turning
-lap times are sent to leaderboards (viewing possible later)

You can request access to the Playtest on the store page, access will be granted immediately.
